scenarios.title: Vault: a full vault never trims or sells; a worthwhile drop is not recorded
scenarios.provenance: SETUP (CHEATED, mechanics only): level and gold by stat verbs, 400 distinct real items taken into the vault by the runner (pre.vault_records), one rare ring on the ground. Not evidence about balance or parity.

assert.why: nothing left and nothing was added
every seeded record is still there
the worthwhile drop is counted as missed, not recorded

scenarios.notes: Vault seeded at capacity (400) with unpinned low-value records, loot.vaultAutoTrim 0 (default), a worthwhile unique drops. Expected: vault count unchanged, every seeded record present, no archive entry, nothing sold, the new drop not recorded and left on the ground, missed counter 1, no Ether gained. RED on the old code is the trim of the lowest record. Assertions to add with the runner support: vault_count 400, vault_records_present seeded, vault_missed >= 1.

scenarios.provenance: SETUP (CHEATED, mechanics only): level and gold by stat verbs, 400 distinct real items taken into the vault by the runner (pre.vault_records), one rare ring on the ground. Not evidence about balance or parity.

assert.why: the API shows the full state

scenarios.notes: Same seed as vault.full-no-trim. GET /api/vault must show capacity.level full, autoTrim false, missed.count >= 1 with the best names, and the banner text 'Vault full: 400/400. New drops are not recorded until you make room.'. Assertions to add: vault_api capacity.level == full, missed.count >= 1, autoTrim == false.
